replaces_for_new_reports: docs/gate_v1.json, which stays on file unchanged (hash 48379c7a...). Both are reported side by side
changes: Any change after this commit is a new version and is logged as a trial.
unchanged_from_v1: scope, universe, trade definition, costs, targets, minimum move, walk-forward folds, forward registry, and the X_h limits in item g, except as stated below

skip_rule.A: a trade is not taken if a listed action's ex-date falls after its entry and on or before its exit. Source: the stored NSE corporate-action files only. Actions: split, bonus, demerger, consolidation. Daily returns on those ex-dates are empty
skip_rule.B: A plus the price / open-interest detector of v1. Report only; never used by the gate
skip_rule.detector: diagnostic only, not an exclusion, because it uses price and open-interest moves inside the trade, which a live trader cannot see at entry
skip_rule.announcement_date: none. caBroadcastDate is empty on all 22,323 stored rows and no other field is an announcement date, so known_from of the action list is UNVERIFIED
skip_rule.coverage_note: the files were fetched for months holding a large move, not by a coverage plan; those four months have no file
skip_rule.no_action_list: a trade is labelled 'no action list' unless every calendar month from entry to exit has a file. Every result is reported with and without those trades

gate.applies_to: a model on the clean forward holdout from 2026-10-27, at 1.5x costs
gate.a: at least 100 distinct signal dates (target 150). Raw trades are reported beside it
gate.c: one-sided exact binomial p < the forward threshold, n = distinct signal dates, wins = win rate x n rounded, null = the measured win rate of the same structure with a random direction on the same trades

d.rule: net expectancy per trade > 0 and the lower bound of a block-bootstrap 95% interval > 0 (whole signal dates, 2000 draws)
d.how_chosen: by null calibration on development trades, rule A, 1,000 runs per cell, at 100 and 150 dates, on four nulls: random direction with costs; zero-mean random direction per row; zero-mean one sign per date; zero-mean one sign per 20 dates. Grid 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30. The block with the lowest worst-case false-pass rate per h
d.note: longer blocks raised the false-pass rate (0.11 to 0.125 at 30 dates): on 100 to 150 dates they leave too few independent blocks. If a window has no more dates than the block, the interval is not estimated and item d fails

gate.e: as v1: net expectancy above always long, always short, previous-day sign, 5-day momentum sign and GARCH risk-scaled long
gate.f: as v1: net expectancy on U2 has the same sign as on U1

g.rule: as v1, at 1.5x costs: (i) net expectancy > 0 in at least 70% of folds; (ii) no fold below -X_h% of notional per trade; (iii) every fold has at least 100 distinct signal dates; a fold below that is a FAIL, not skipped
g.x_h_note: the v1 values, measured with v1's skip rule; not re-measured

tiers.reporting_rule: both are reported. A model can pass Tier 1 and fail Tier 2; that result must not be reworded as a pass of the 60% gate

multiple_testing.trial_counter: keeps counting every distinct spec, horizon, universe, target and threshold
multiple_testing.forward_test: the correction applies across the specs tested forward, which must be pre-registered and at most 3, not across all trials

validation: 2023-2024 has been seen for baselines only. It is still used once per frozen model spec
